Reason (R): Under FR 9(13), a lien represents the title of a government servant to hold substantively a permanent post, which ceases once they are confirmed in another permanent post.

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Appointed on an ad-hoc basis for a project
Appointed substantively to a permanent post

explanation_english: Under Fundamental Rule 13, a government servant acquires a lien on a post automatically when they are appointed substantively to a permanent post. A lien represents the legal right to hold a permanent post substantively, which continues during deputation, foreign service, or authorized leave until legally suspended or terminated.

explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। वर्तमान वेतन नियमों के तहत, जब केंद्रीय सरकार के कर्मचारियों द्वारा प्राप्त महंगाई भत्ता 50% के स्तर को पार करता है, तो X, Y, और Z श्रेणी के शहरों के लिए HRA की दरें क्रमशः 30%, 20%, और 10% में स्वचालित रूप से संशोधित की जाती हैं ताकि जीवन यापन की बढ़ती लागत को संतुलित किया जा सके।
topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: HRA rates are revised based on the threshold of Dearness Allowance (DA).
When DA crosses 50%, HRA rates are 30%, 20%, and 10% for X, Y, and Z cities respectively.
This adjustment helps in managing increased living costs.
Printed answer key: (B) 30%, 20%, 10%

question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the admissibility of HRA:
I. HRA is not admissible if the government servant’s spouse has been allotted government accommodation at the same station.
II. HRA can be drawn during Earned Leave up to a maximum period of 180 days.
III. HRA is paid at reduced rates during a period of suspension.
IV. HRA is admissible during maternity leave.
Which of the above statements are correct?
explanation_english: House Rent Allowance is inadmissible if an employee’s spouse resides in allotted government housing at the same station. HRA is drawn during earned leave up to 180 days and during maternity leave. During suspension, HRA is drawn based on pre-suspension pay rates, not reduced rates.

key_facts: HRA is not admissible if the spouse has government accommodation.

Printed answer key: (B) I, II and IV

question_english: An employee who is allotted a government flat sub-lets it to a private individual and moves to a rented accommodation. They subsequently apply for HRA. Which administrative rule applies here?
options_english: They are entitled to HRA as long as they reside in a rented house and produce valid rent receipts.
They are entitled to 50% HRA provided they obtain prior approval from the Head of Department.
They are entitled to HRA but strictly calculated at the minimum prescribed slab rate for that station.
They get no HRA and face action for subletting government quarters.
explanation_english: Sub-letting government accommodation is a severe violation of allotment rules. An employee who sub-lets government quarters forfeits all entitlements to House Rent Allowance. In addition, the employee faces departmental disciplinary proceedings, cancellation of allotment, eviction, and penal rent recovery under administrative rules for unauthorized subletting.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सरकारी आवास को उप-भाड़े पर देना आवंटन नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है। एक कर्मचारी जो सरकारी क्वार्टरों को उप-भाड़े पर देता है, HRA के सभी अधिकारों को खो देता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, कर्मचारी विभागीय अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही, आवंटन की रद्दीकरण, निष्कासन, और अनधिकृत उप-भाड़े के लिए दंडात्मक किराया वसूली का सामना करता है।
topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Sub-letting government accommodation is a violation of rules.

Printed answer key: (D) They get no HRA and face action for subletting government quarters.

question_english: If a government servant is appointed to officiate in a higher post, what is the fundamental requirement under FR 22 for their pay to be fixed in the higher time-scale?

The appointment must involve duties or responsibilities of greater importance.
There is no specific requirement for pay fixation in the higher time-scale.

explanation_english: Under Fundamental Rule 22, when a government servant is appointed to officiate in a higher post, their pay is fixed in the higher time-scale only if the appointment involves the assumption of duties and responsibilities of greater importance than those attached to the post held previously by the employee.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। FR 22 के तहत, जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी को उच्च पद पर कार्यकारी नियुक्त किया जाता है, तो उनके वेतन को उच्च समय-मान में केवल तभी निर्धारित किया जाता है जब नियुक्ति में उन कार्यों और जिम्मेदारियों का समावेश हो जो पहले के पद की तुलना में अधिक महत्वपूर्ण हों।

question_english: When an employee is transferred on their own request (and not in the public interest) to a lower post, how is their pay fixed under FR 22?
options_english: Pay is fixed directly at the maximum cell of the lower post’s pay scale without any protection.
Pay is fully protected, allowing the employee to continue drawing the higher substantive pay.
Pay is placed at the equal stage, or next below stage, in the lower scale.
Pay is automatically reduced by exactly two regular increments in the applicable lower scale.
explanation_english: When a government servant is transferred to a lower post on their own voluntary request, pay protection of higher substantive pay is not granted. Under Fundamental Rule 22, the employee’s pay is fixed at the stage equal to their pay in the higher post, or at the next lower stage.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी अपनी इच्छा पर निम्न पद पर स्थानांतरित होता है, तो उच्च मौलिक वेतन की सुरक्षा प्रदान नहीं की जाती है। FR 22 के तहत, कर्मचारी का वेतन उनके उच्च पद के वेतन के समान चरण पर या अगले निम्न चरण पर निर्धारित किया जाता है।
topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR

Printed answer key: (c) Pay is placed at the equal stage, or next below stage, in the lower scale.

question_english:

I. Advance increments can be granted for passing specific departmental examinations if provided by rules.
II. Advance increments for acquiring higher educational qualifications (like Ph.D.) have been replaced by one-time lump-sum incentives in many cases.

explanation_english: Advance increments can be granted for passing specified departmental examinations or achieving sports excellence without affecting annual increments. question_english:
A teacher was wrongfully dismissed from service but later reinstated by a court order, which explicitly ruled that the period of absence be treated as “duty for all purposes”. Will this period count for earning increments?
(A) Yes, periods declared as duty count for increments under FR 26
(B) No, since the teacher did not physically perform regular classroom teaching duties
